_comment: OTA-234 — ingested from loot_and_treasure_table.docx. 47 canonical loot / treasure / artifact entries (Ancient Tartarian Crown, Aetherstone Pendant, Royal Tartarian Jewelry Set, etc.). Lore-only; promotion to authored loot tables is per-OTA.

items.notes: Symbol of ancient royalty, priceless to collectors

items.name: Old World Jewelry Box

items.name: Etheric Painting

items.notes: Highly valuable due to the diamonds and craftsmanship

items.name: Tartarian Noble's Headdress
items.notes: Valuable cultural relic, prized by collectors

items.notes: Rare blueprint, valuable to corporations and factions

items.name: Etheric Relic (Minor)

items.name: Obsidian Tablet (Fragment)
items.notes: Holds partial knowledge of Tartarian history, valuable to scholars

items.name: Old World Cash Bundle
items.notes: Currency from the pre-collapse era, still usable in trade

items.name: Aether-Crafted Ring

items.notes: Grants minor Etheric power, highly valuable

items.name: Royal Tartarian Jewelry Set
items.source: Found in the tomb of a Tartarian queen
items.notes: Complete set of crown, rings, and necklace, extremely valuable

items.name: Ancient Armor Plate
items.notes: Historical relic, not usable as armor but valuable to collectors

items.name: Precious Stones (Raw)
items.notes: Used for crafting jewelry or for trade

items.name: Damaged Etheric Core

items.notes: Can be repaired or sold as salvageable tech

items.name: Old World Weapons Cache
items.source: Found in a hidden military bunker
items.notes: Contains multiple pre-collapse weapons, valuable to collectors

items.name: Gold-Plated Etheric Chalice
items.source: Found in a royal Tartarian vault
items.notes: Infused with Etheric energy, valuable and powerful artifact

items.name: Cybernetic Implant (Damaged)
items.notes: Usable for repair or research, valuable to tech factions

items.name: Old World Medicine Stash
items.notes: Includes valuable pre-collapse medical supplies

items.name: Etheric Lantern (Antique)
items.notes: Usable for Etheric light, prized for its historical value

items.name: Mud Monarch's Scepter
items.source: Found in a Mud Monarch tomb
items.notes: Symbol of power, valuable to collectors and traders

items.name: Damaged Etheric Staff
items.notes: Can be repaired or sold as a minor relic

items.name: Old World Artifacts (Common)
items.notes: Various antique tools and relics, valuable in bulk

items.name: Royal Tartarian Shield
items.notes: Not usable in combat, but highly prized as a historical relic

items.name: Etheric Spellbook (Damaged)
items.notes: Contains Etheric spells, valuable for scholars or mages

items.name: Aether-Engraved Vase
items.notes: Prized for its craftsmanship and Etheric infusion

items.name: Reclaimed Fusion Core
items.notes: Usable for powering advanced technology

items.name: Obsidian Crown (Shattered)
items.notes: Still valuable as a relic despite its damage

items.name: Tartarian Scholar's Tome
items.notes: Holds vast knowledge prized by historians and scholars

items.name: Zalmar Frequency Harmonizer
items.notes: A handheld brass-and-aether-glass device of the philosopher-scientist Elior Zalmar, built to monitor the Aetherons of the Etheric Field and head off a resonance cascade.

items.name: Sentinel Commander's Crest
items.source: Asgardar — the Grand Spire of Asgardar
items.notes: A high officer's badge that hums at a frequency Architectural Sentinels read as Royal Authority — its bearer can issue commands to legions of the ancient machines.

items.name: Mud Flood Nexus Pulse-Key
items.source: The Mud Flood Nexus, deep in the Aetherstone Deep
items.notes: A massive control interface for the subterranean systems that regulated the empire's geology. Rumored to be able to trigger — or reverse — a secondary cataclysm. Coveted by the Mud Monarchs.

items.name: Eternal Dynasty's Blood-Signet
items.source: Hidden sanctuaries in the spires of Asgardar or Nimari
items.notes: A ring of refined Aetherstone that glows in the presence of Aetherborn. The Tartarian elite used it to verify bloodline purity; it remains a symbol of the Eternal Dynasty's divine right.

items.name: Fragment of the Endless Stair
items.source: The Endless Stair, near the impassable disturbance at its base
items.notes: A heavy stone step broken from the legendary vertical conduit between the surface and the mantle. Unnaturally dense, as if it still carries the gravity of the Aetherstone Deep.

items.name: Mask of Tartaria's Last King
items.source: True Tartarian Catacombs / the Royal Vaults beneath Asgardar
items.notes: A mask said to grant visions of the empire's final moments. The True Tartarians revere it as a sacred link to their ancestral history.

items.name: Aetheric Phoenix Feather
items.source: The partially submerged Sinking Cathedral in the Mud Seas
items.notes: A feather radiating intense heat, as if its bird was forged from raw Aetheric energy. Said to hold the power of rebirth — even to resurrect fallen allies.

items.name: Wrath of the Ether Titan
items.source: The Giant Vault in the Ural Mountains
items.notes: A two-handed hammer of the ancient Tartarian Giants that calls localized Etheric storms on impact. Forged to defend the empire's most sacred vaults.

items.name: Timeworn Ether Compass
items.source: The Cradle of Dusk, within the Mud Seas
items.notes: A navigation tool that always points to the strongest source of Etheric energy, ignoring magnetic interference. Said to defy time, showing paths to cities not yet unlocked from the mud.

items.name: Heart of the Ether Dragon
items.source: The Lost Capital of Drakova, rumored to hold an intact core
items.notes: A preserved, pulsing energy core from a legendary creature of the old world — one of the most powerful fuel sources in existence, able to power an Etheric Chamber for centuries.

items.name: Aetherstorm Shard
items.source: The Great Tartary Plains, near the original resonance-cascade site
items.notes: A jagged, volatile crystal containing a miniature storm; it discharges violet lightning without pause. A prime component for crafting the most powerful legendary runecasters.

items.name: Architect's Master Blueprint
items.notes: An ancient slate of the original engineering designs for Tartaria's floating towers and hovering citadels. The Forgotten Order covets these to rebuild the world's lost infrastructure.

items.name: Sovereign Ether Crown
items.source: The Royal Vaults deep beneath Asgardar
items.notes: The first crown ever worn by a Tartarian king, believed to grant ultimate control over the empire's energy networks — a relic of the zenith of human achievement before the fall.

items.name: Obsidian Siphon
items.source: The Obsidian Pillars in the Great Tartary Plains
items.notes: A specialized tool for bleeding magnetic energy from the Obsidian Pillars. Essential to researchers trying to stabilize Etheric grids without traditional power sources.

items.name: The Entombed's Prayer Tablet
items.source: Subterranean Catacombs / buried homes in the Buried Cities
items.notes: A spiritual tablet used to honor the Giants as divine architects. Frequently found in buried homes where families were sealed in time by the Flood.
